root_cause.trajectory_summary: The agent translated /root/Tokenizer.py into idiomatic Scala 2.13 at /root/Tokenizer.scala. It inspected the Python source, verified the Scala compiler, and iteratively produced a translation covering all required names (TokenType, Token, BaseTokenizer, StringTokenizer, NumericTokenizer, TemporalTokenizer, UniversalTokenizer, WhitespaceTokenizer, TokenizerBuilder, tokenize, tokenizeBatch, toToken, withMetadata). It fixed two compile issues (invalid f-interpolator syntax, missing implicitConversions import) and resolved an overload ambiguity between Any-based and type-class-based tokenize by redesigning Tokenizable as a subtype trait dispatched via pattern match. It wrote a behavioral test file (TokenizerTest.scala), compiled and ran it (Turn 16: "All tests passed."), cleaned up the test artifacts (Turn 17), reran a final compile check (Turn 18: "Final compile: OK"), reviewed the final source (Turn 19), and delivered a final summary message (Turn 20).

what_worked.item: Turn 16: scalac + running TokenizerTest produced "All tests passed." with exit code 0, confirming behavioral correctness across StringTokenizer, NumericTokenizer, TemporalTokenizer, UniversalTokenizer, WhitespaceTokenizer, TokenizerBuilder, Token.withMetadata, and tokenizeBatch.

Turn 19 view confirms all required names are present: TokenType (sealed abstract + case objects), Token (case class with withMetadata using copy), BaseTokenizer[A] (abstract with tokenize + tokenizeBatch returning Iterator), StringTokenizer, NumericTokenizer[A: Numeric], TemporalTokenizer, UniversalTokenizer (Any pattern match), WhitespaceTokenizer, TokenizerBuilder (immutable fluent builder), plus Tokenizable trait exposing toToken.

Idiomatic choices: sealed ADTs for str|bytes and datetime|date, Option for absence, immutable default Map.empty (fixing Python's mutable-default bug), Numeric type class for NumericTokenizer, lazy Iterator from IterableOnce for tokenizeBatch.
Turn 17: cleaned up transient test artifacts so the workspace contains only Tokenizer.py and Tokenizer.scala as required.
